title: Заложник в багажнике  (Hostage in the Trunk)

segments.t: Out in the courtyard, Senya and Fedya check the unconscious photographer's pulse and breathe a sigh of relief when he wakes up. After looking through the photos on his camera, they force the terrified man out of the front seat so he cannot escape.
Все, я больше так не могу, я сдаюсь.
Ну ты заткнись и сиди спокойно.
Ты дебил, что ли, это удалить надо?
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'No, he is not alive.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'there is no' and 'not' in a few short words.
'Wait, no, he seems to be alive.' The meaning hinges on 'there is no' working together with 'seemingly' in spoken Russian. Fedya answers right away.
Все, я больше так не могу, я сдаюсь.
'That is it, I cannot take this anymore, I give up.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'all' and 'I' in a few short words.
'Shut up, got it?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'shut up' before landing on 'understood?'.
Ну ты заткнись и сиди спокойно.
'Just shut up and sit still.' Notice the reflexive suffix on the verb meaning 'shut up', turning the action back on the subject. Vika answers right away.
'Let us see what is on there right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'any minute' before landing on 'there'.
Ты дебил, что ли, это удалить надо?
'Are you an idiot or what, we have to delete this!' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'at' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'What is going to happen to us now?' Vika raises the pitch on 'will' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Fedya answers right away.
'As our captain used to say.' The grammar packs 'how' and 'captain' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Get out of the car.' The meaning hinges on 'marry' working together with 'cars' in spoken Russian.
'Can I just go home?' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'go' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.
'Get out of the car right now.' In Russian, the idea of 'to go out' flows naturally into 'cars' without extra filler words.
'Right now, how?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'any minute' before landing on 'how'. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Все, я больше так не могу, я сдаюсь.
Ну ты заткнись и сиди спокойно.
Ты дебил, что ли, это удалить надо?
